title: Employers are quietly rehiring the people AI replaced, and paying them less to come back
summary: Forrester reports that 55% of employers regret laying off workers for AI and expects half of AI-attributed layoffs to be quietly reversed, with jobs returning offshore or at significantly lower wages.
